summary: Backend and infrastructure engineer with 9 years of experience building distributed systems, data pipelines and developer platforms at high-growth companies. Led migrations to Kubernetes, cut cloud spend by millions, and mentor engineers across teams.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
highlights: Led the migration of 140 services from EC2 to Kubernetes (EKS) with zero customer-facing downtime, cutting deploy time from 45 to 8 minutes.
Designed a multi-region event bus on Kafka handling 2.1M events per second with p99 latency under 40 ms.
Built a cost-attribution pipeline in Go and BigQuery that surfaced $3.4M in annual cloud savings.
Introduced Terraform modules and policy-as-code (OPA) adopted by 22 teams, reducing infrastructure incidents by 38%.
Mentored 6 engineers; two were promoted to senior within 18 months.

experience.title: Software Engineer II, Data Infrastructure
highlights: Rebuilt the batch ingestion platform on Spark and Airflow, processing 18 TB per day with 99.95% on-time delivery.
Shipped a streaming feature store (Flink, Redis) that cut model feature latency from hours to seconds.
Reduced warehouse query costs 41% by introducing partitioning, clustering and a query linting service.
Owned on-call for the data platform and wrote runbooks that halved mean time to recovery.
Partnered with ML teams to productionize 12 models with automated validation and rollback.

experience.title: Software Engineer, Backend
highlights: Built HIPAA-compliant REST and gRPC APIs in Python and Go serving 3M patient records.
Implemented audit logging and field-level encryption that passed SOC 2 Type II on the first attempt.
Cut API p95 latency 60% by adding caching, connection pooling and query optimization in PostgreSQL.
Automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions and blue-green deploys, raising release frequency from weekly to daily.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
highlights: Prototyped a log search service in Elasticsearch that became the team's default debugging tool.
Wrote integration tests that raised coverage of the billing service from 48% to 81%.
Turing Scholars honors program
Teaching assistant, Operating Systems
